messages:
jessica: Quick monthly pattern synthesis — noticed 3 incidents this month (GEN-112, GEN-118, KVS-55) showing similar KV cache thrash leading to model OOMs. Can we collect root-cause themes and assign remediation owners? :eyes:

raj: Yep saw those. GEN-118 was the worst. I can dig into eviction policy differences across nodes.

marta: I'll pull the postmortems and surface common stack traces + p95 memory timelines.

oncall-bot: Incident list: https://redwood.incidents/GEN-112, GEN-118, KVS-55 | Metrics: https://grafana.redwood/board/kv-cache

sam: Suggest we add a saturation alert on kv_cache_hit_rate and a circuit-breaker to fall back to smaller context models for susceptible tenants.

jessica: Proposed actions:
- A1: Revisit KV cache eviction heuristics (owner: raj) — ETA 2026-04-10
- A2: Add KV saturation alert + runbook (owner: sam) — ETA 2026-03-30
- A3: Automate canary fallback to smaller model when KV misses spike (owner: marta) — ETA 2026-04-15
- A4: Patch the largest offending model config (owner: raj & infra) — ETA 2026-04-05

raj: I'll create GH issues and link postmortems. Will start with A1 and A4.

marta: I'll produce a short doc with the trace snippets and suggested telemetry fields by EOD Friday.

sam: I'll draft the alert + runbook and post in #eng-oncall for review.

jessica: Please update the incident tracker with issue numbers. We'll re-check status in two weeks and close items when PRs merged. If anyone needs more time post here.

raj: Assigned A1 to self: https://github.com/redwood/infra/issues/459

marta: Doc uploaded: https://docs.redwood/internal/kv-cache-patterns (summary attached)

sam: Alert PR open: https://github.com/redwood/ops/pull/301 — requesting review from @oncall

oncall-bot: Reminder set: check-in meeting 2026-04-01 10:00 UTC — calendar invite sent.

jessica: Thanks team. Noting recurring theme: KV cache saturation + aggressive eviction leads to cascades. Need medium-term work on smarter cache warming and model routing. Marking this thread as action tracker. :thumbsup:
